column3: Saori Route · It's Too Weird
Hey... Did something happen?
What do you mean by "something"...?
Don't answer a question with another question. I'm the one asking questions here.
Eh, that means...
Did I just raise a flag with Kyousuke-shi?
Nope, that didn't happen.
Ugh... Completely denied...
Seems like I'm a totally irrelevant existence in the eyes of Kyousuke-shi.
I-I didn't say that though...
In fact, I asked "what happened?" precisely because I was worried.
That means that, you actually... about me...
Keeping quiet... So that means...
You approve and accept it?
No no, I was just shocked and at a loss for words.
Hahaha! There's no need to be shy!
Besides...
I don't mind the slightest...
A shy and slightly embarrassed Saori... I-Isn't she cute!? My heart skipped a beat there!
Playing meek like that... She does have a cute side to her!
However, I'm terribly sorry, Kyousuke-shi... I cannot be involved in an affair at the moment.
Eh? What are you talking about?
Well, about the flag.
Like I said, a breach of etiquette like raising a flag with you would be...
Ah... but, if Kyousuke-shi insists so...
I'll respectfully refrain from doing that.
Politely turned down?!
No, I can't cause a misunderstanding like that to a girl even as a joke.
That's right. No matter how much of an otaku she looks like, she's still a delicate girl at heart.
As a guy, I have to behave like a gentleman.
As expected of Kyousuke-shi... You sure know how to treat a lady.
Having such a sister, any other girl would seem like an angel.
Basically, I'm like an angel for Kyousuke-shi.
It was just an example.
Hahaha! Just joking!
W-Wait, Kyousuke-shi.
Say something about my comment!
Eh? Ah, ah, sorry.
I heard something that I couldn't understand, so my brain froze.
To the point of mental breakdown?!
Though, you really overflow with manliness when you state things.
Aah... If only I could be as brave as you are!
No, I don't think you should follow my example!
Although you're dressed like this, you're still a proper girl.
I-Is that so?
But even girls can fail at managing flags. Especially...
...friendship flags are difficult to manage.
Hm? What did say?
Nothing at all.
Whatever, just answer me. What's up with you?
Whatever...?
That's what you just said, right?
Y-Yes, so what?
So you're telling me "there's no need for you to be brave"?
Guhh... it's not what I meant.
Anyway, answer my question first. Tell me honestly; what happened?
Kyousuke-shi clinging onto me and questioning me with obstinacy...
Could it be... some kind of conspiracy?!
Ah, I give up! I'll swing the flag!
Hahaha! You're raising the white flag a little too early, aren't you?
But no matter how many times you ask, my reply will be "Nothing".
Hehehe! Kyousuke-shi is really acting his age!
Guys in their adolescence are indeed very interested in the opposite gender.
I... would be lying if I said otherwise... But!
I don't want to listen about such stuff at all now!
I understand!
What you want to know is whether I have a boyfriend or not, right?
NOTTTTTT!!!!!!!!!!!
Kyousuke-shi, I have a piece of advice for you.
W-What is it...?
When you're wooing a girl you like, being too persistent will get you disliked instead.
